caption: The drawing is presented on a plain, lightly textured, off-white background and consists of two views of a single object traced in thin black lines. The object appears to be a rectangular frame with a scalloped or wavy decorative top. At the top center of the frame, within the scalloped area, there is a symmetrical carved motif resembling a stylized heart or leaf, with two inner shapes dividing the design. The front view shows the frame as a large rectangle with a border and the ornamental top. To the right, there is a side profile view of the same object, which reveals the frame's depth and the protruding upper section with the same wavy contour seen from the side. The drawing is monochrome, utilizing only black outlines with no shading or color fill.
title: Mirror
